scientific_scope: Experimental normal-data C++ LowCardinality fresh-dictionary adoption on full native PromQL versus exactly matched O1 control. Four ABBA cases, all output parity and drift gates passed. NO production safety claim.

fixture.storage: Same v11 default LC UUID TimeSeries table read by both executables, inner 3 targets exactly 1 active part each after OPTIMIZE FINAL, merges stopped

method.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange(churn_ts,'avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(jenkins_ci_95k_daily{selector}[1d]))',start,end,86400) with max_threads=2 and source-pinned full native computation
method.phases: For each case, independent fresh server per baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline phase; 2 warmups+6 measured queries; all query ids phase-specific; same physical parts, same query and same user
method.metrics: Client p50/p95, QueryFinish OSCPUVirtualTime, runnable wait, read rows/bytes/SelectedMarks, query peak memory, low-overhead /proc server VmRSS, representative processors_profile_log grouped work, trace_log categories when available
method.confidence_gate: A/A control drift <=25% for wall p50 and CPU. All passed; robust gain requires improvement exceed measured drift and no safety regressions.
method.safety: Candidate bypasses ColumnLowCardinality::checkIndexesAreLimited for no-global fresh dictionary adoption and assumes unique dictionary keys. Known source audit blocks deployment regardless of normal-data performance.

stage.judgment: REJECT; strong same-runner 11.6% p50 and 10.7% CPU regression

whole.judgment: INCONCLUSIVE; 2.4% wall change close to 2.8% drift

profiles.sampled_cpu_trace_status: No rows in cpu_components, folded_stacks or hot_leaves in final artifact for either variant; cannot attribute trace CPU hotspots or claim dictionary ReverseIndex elimination in actual run. Investigate trace_log sampling availability separately if this hypothesis were to be reopened.
profiles.interpretation: In stage, the representative sum of recorded processor work changes by ~2ms despite median QueryFinish total CPU +182ms and client wall +107ms. It is not valid to attribute regression to a specific C++ call path or mutex from available trace. QueryFinish CPU counts can include work not mapped to per-processor elapsed groups; single profiled query is not median.
profiles.off_cpu_note: Processor input/output waits sum across instances and cannot be interpreted as critical-path wall time or contended mutex wait.

source_safety.necessary_gate: Retain stock INCORRECT_DATA semantics and index type checks for bad 8/16/32/64 indexes; prove or check dictionary uniqueness, continuation, nullable and merge behavior before any future C++ optimization.

comparison_to_existing_optin_raw_uuid: Do not multiply theoretical LC patch benefit with raw UUID schema gain; both target overlapping LowCardinality dictionary work and experimental patch is rejected on measured performance and known correctness risk.
limitations: Valid synthetic fixture only, no malformed-index runtime test, sanitizer, hot production data, 8-client capacity or production jemalloc; does not imply stock LC format is globally inferior. Trace CPU sampling missing in artifact, so no causal function-stack attribution.
next_action: Close R12 unguarded LC adoption as rejected.
